```{r, results='asis'}
fishery_pages <- tinyAM:::.fishery_pages(obs_pred$catch)
for (page_index in seq_len(nrow(fishery_pages))) {
  page <- fishery_pages[page_index, ]
  child_env <- new.env(parent = environment())
  child_env$fishery_page <- page
  if (page$kind == "fleet") {
    child_env$catch_data <- obs_pred$catch[which(as.character(obs_pred$catch$fleet) == page$fleet), ]
    child_env$F_data <- if (is.null(pop$F_fleet)) NULL else pop$F_fleet[which(as.character(pop$F_fleet$fleet) == page$fleet), ]
    child_env$mean_data <- if (is.null(pop$mu_F_fleet)) NULL else pop$mu_F_fleet[which(as.character(pop$mu_F_fleet$fleet) == page$fleet), ]
    child_env$yield_data <- tinyAM:::.fleet_yield_data(pop, page$fleet)
    child <- "one_fleet.Rmd"
  } else {
    catch_data <- obs_pred$catch
    fleet <- as.character(catch_data$fleet)
    if (length(fleet)) {
      catch_data <- catch_data[is.na(fleet) | !nzchar(fleet), , drop = FALSE]
    }
    child_env$catch_data <- catch_data
    child <- if (nrow(fishery_pages) > 1L && NROW(catch_data) == 0L) {
      "fishery_total.Rmd"
    } else {
      "fishery.Rmd"
    }
  }
  rendered <- knitr::knit_child(child, envir = child_env, quiet = TRUE)
  cat(rendered, sep = "\n")
}
```
